(2) A hand enters the frame and lifts the yellow sheet, revealing the girl sitting on the floor laughing. She points her finger and gestures while looking at the camera. (3) The girl sits cross-legged under the yellow sheet 'castle' holding a children's book with an orange cover. She looks up and interacts with the person filming. (4) An orange and white cat walks into the frame from behind a wooden chair leg, approaching some plush toys on the floor near the girl's play area. (5) The girl stands up and walks out from under the yellow sheet, lifting it over her head. The camera follows her as she moves toward the bookshelf. (6) The girl stands in front of a shelf and begins to play a small toy piano. She presses the keys with her right hand while the yellow sheet remains partially over her shoulder. (7) A final transition screen appears with a pink background and a cartoon illustration of the girl, featuring the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
